meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills

howto.what: 它读取本机 screenpipe 记录的你近期屏幕内容,找出重复出现的工作流程,与仓库已有技能比对,把尚未覆盖的写成新技能草稿或组合配方,放进待审核目录。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近几小时、一天或一周的工作并提出技能建议时触发;本机 screenpipe 守护进程须在 3030 端口运行,连不上就拒绝运行。

howto.what_en: It reads your recent screen activity captured locally by screenpipe, finds repeated work workflows, compares them with existing skills in the repo, and drafts new skills or composition recipes into a review folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to analyze your recent work and propose skills. The local screenpipe daemon must be running on port 3030; it refuses to run if screenpipe is unreachable.

say_en.text: Show repeated workflows not covered by existing skills
